summary: Avoid repeated ancestor walks in project containment checks

delivery.outcome: Independently publish and deploy equivalent lexical containment checks that allow project inventory to complete on the live host without repeated ancestor traversal.
nonGoals: No cleanup eligibility, process protection, retention or storage-floor changes
No filesystem resolution or removal of unknown work
No MCP schema or new runtime dependency

architecture.decision: Compare native-case normalized anchors and path component prefixes, preserving lexical containment while avoiding Path.parents enumeration per process/project pair.
architecture.rollback: Revert through independent protected publication and reinstall the previous reviewed artifact.
